name: filestation-webservice
description: Private file transfer station web application

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace=@filestation/server && npm run build --workspace=@filestation/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && cross-env FILESTATION_WEB_URL=http://localhost:5173 concurrently "npm run dev --workspace=@filestation/server" "npm run dev --workspace=@filestation/web"
